signature.one_line: Frenetic one-feature-one-shot product ad: small lowercase wide-grotesque running captions that swap to huge stacked UPPERCASE keyword cards on each selling point.
unique_devices: Two-tier text at one centre point (50 % H): running line in lowercase wide regular grotesque 50 px with no punctuation; key claims become a 2-4-line UPPERCASE extra-bold 98 px card (line pitch 84 px, ~0.86 leading) that replaces the running line on the same frame, ~1 card every ~120 frames
Claim card on from frame 0 over the speaker holding the product, then washed out by a 12-frame full-frame brand-colour light flash as the pattern interrupt
One feature = one insert shown in the same second it is said (macro, overhead top-down, live proof such as a water spray); median shot ~31 frames, never over ~90
Close on a slow push into a macro of the logo with the product name as the final card
signature.why_it_works: The claim is said and shown at once, a colour flash breaks the frame early, and every feature is proven on screen as big cards make selling points skimmable.

hook.type: bold claim + pattern interrupt (full-frame colour flash)
hook.first_frame: smiling speaker in a warm practical-lit room holding the product to camera under a centred 4-line heavy UPPERCASE claim card

structure.what: claim card over the speaker, product swung at the lens, full-frame colour flash
product worn / in use, design statement in running captions
feature run: one insert per feature, keyword cards on headline features
live demonstration of the boldest claim + a surprise feature
speaker's soft buy line, then macro logo shot with the product-name card

pacing.note: ~60 cuts/min in the opening, ~36 after; cuts land on motion (swings, hands, zips); 64 % J/L; continuous VO, no pauses

captions.when: 0-100 % except while a card is up
captions.how: wide regular grotesque 50 px white, no punctuation (hyphens kept), no box/shadow; 2-5 words, one line, centre 50.2 %; hard cut ~7 frames after the phrase starts; carries across picture cuts

motion_graphics.how: 12 frames of saturated yellow light washing out the claim card, then hard cut to the body

motion_graphics.what: red light leak along the bottom edge
motion_graphics.how: soft organic leak over ~75 frames, low opacity

cards_lists.when: hook claim, three headline features, product name (~1 per 120 frames)
cards_lists.how: extra-bold neo-grotesque 98 px, -0.02em, 1-2 words per line, 2-4 lines, line pitch 84 px, white, soft dark shadow 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.35), no box; block centre 50 %, widest line ~49 % W; hard cut in replacing the running line

broll_inserts.what: product inserts: handheld macros, locked overhead top-downs, in-use shots
broll_inserts.how: one feature per shot, 13-90 frames, shown the moment it is named; overhead packing can be sped up

broll_inserts.what: live proof of the boldest claim
broll_inserts.how: wide demo then macro detail of the result (~50 frames total)

layout.how: text centred at mid-frame over footage

camera.what: locked shots of the speaker, handheld macros, overhead top-downs
camera.how: no punch-ins on the speaker; slow push-in on the final logo macro

transitions.how: cut on product swings, hands and zips so motion blur bridges the cut

end_card.what: product-name card over a macro logo shot
end_card.how: keyword-card style (UPPERCASE 98 px, 2 lines) over a slow push into the logo; no separate end card

case.running: all lowercase, even at a sentence start

captions_spec.punctuation: running: none (full stops and commas dropped; hyphens kept); card: apostrophes and the inch mark kept
captions_spec.numbers: digits (with unit marks such as the inch mark on cards)

grouping.sync: phrase-by-phrase; a card replaces the running line for its key phrase (5 cards: the hook claim, three headline features, the product name)
grouping.break: running line changes every 2-5 words; captions and cards carry over picture cuts unchanged

layout.on_1080x1920: same 9:16 canvas: both tiers centred at x 540 px, y ≈ 962 px; card line pitch 84 px

running.font_class: wide (extended) grotesque, regular weight, open apertures, single-storey g
running.k_note: calibration phrases have ascenders and descenders -> k 0.99: 2.34 x 19.2 / 0.99 = 45 px; render-verified with Syne 400: 50 px
running.calibration_note: measured on two lowercase phrases with ascenders and descenders over a dark jacket (clean)

card.k_note: all caps, no descenders -> k 0.73: 3.87 x 19.2 / 0.73 = 102 px; render-verified with Inter 800: 98 px
card.calibration_note: measured over dark product surfaces; lines running over a bright lamp were not used; other card lines read 3.83-3.91 % H
card.leading: tight: line pitch 4.4 % H (≈0.86 x font size)

animation.running_entry: hard cut, whole phrase at once (no per-word reveal, no fade)
animation.card_entry: hard cut, whole card at once; replaces the running line on the same frame
animation.timing: ~7 frames after the phrase's first transcript word (running lines and cards alike)
animation.exit: hard cut to the next phrase/card; text survives picture cuts unchanged
animation.transition_note: the first card is washed out by a full-frame yellow light-flash transition (12 frames) and hard-cuts to the running line

other_text_spec.when: hook claim from frame 0 (~0-10 % of runtime), then ~23 %, ~39-46 %, ~68-71 %, and ~88-100 % (product name)
other_text_spec.text: see captions_spec.type.card; the final card is the product name over a macro logo shot

other_text_spec.type: titles / lower-thirds / logos / stickers / end card
other_text_spec.text: none; one full-frame yellow flash (12 frames, ~8-10 % of runtime) and a red light leak are footage effects, not text

style.look_intent: cinematic warm-on-cool: tungsten practicals against cool grey walls, deep blacks, slightly desaturated; dark contrasty macros

sound.music: voice only (no bed detected); VO recorded separately over the b-roll
sfx: hits on ~43 % of hard cuts (measured cut_hit_share 0.43): whoosh/hit on product swings and card swaps
riser or impact into the colour flash (suggestion)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Product Advertisement
catalog_styles.role: overall format: claim, features, proof, product name

catalog_styles.name: Product Close-Up / Macro Shots
catalog_styles.role: one macro or top-down per feature

catalog_styles.name: Whiteout
catalog_styles.role: full-frame colour flash as pattern interrupt

catalog_styles.name: Light-Leak Transitions
catalog_styles.role: one red light leak early in the body

use_when: advertising a physical product with several features that can each be shown in one shot
the user has product macros / top-downs plus a short creator intro and VO
a punchy short ad with skimmable selling points is wanted
the brand has a strong single colour for a flash interrupt
avoid_when: a talking-head explainer with little product footage
a calm, slow premium mood (this is frenetic)
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B14 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B14.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps. All positions are % of frame; px are at 1080x1920.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} must stay >= 3:1 on the footage at mid-frame; place cards over dark product surfaces)
- {{TEXT}}      running captions and keyword cards       default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}}    full-frame flash colour                  default saturated yellow (not measured; use the brand's signature colour)
- {{ACCENT_2}}  light-leak tint                          default warm red (footage effect, low opacity)
- {{SURFACE}}   none                                     default none
- {{CARD_BG}}   none (cards have no box)                 default none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} keyword cards                         default Inter 800 (extra-bold neo-grotesque; alt Archivo Black)
- {{FONT_BODY}}    running captions                      default Syne 400 (wide regular grotesque; alt Archivo SemiExpanded)
- {{HANDLE}}    not shown
- {{LOGO}}      the product's own logo, filmed in macro for the final shot

CAPTIONS (two tiers, same centre point)
1. Running caption: English as spoken, ALL LOWERCASE, no full stops or commas (keep hyphens), 2-5 words, one line. {{FONT_BODY}} at 50 px, tracking 0, {{TEXT}}, no stroke, shadow or box. Centred at x 540 px, centre y 50.2 % (~964 px).
2. Keyword cards: ~5 per video (the hook claim, each headline feature, the product name) shown INSTEAD of the running line: UPPERCASE, 1-2 words per line, 2-4 lines, {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 98 px, tracking -0.02em, line pitch 84 px (line-height ~0.86), {{TEXT}}, soft dark shadow 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.35), no box; block centred at x 540 px, y 50 %; widest line ~49 % W. Keep apostrophes and unit marks.
3. Animation: both tiers hard-cut in as a whole phrase ~7 frames after the phrase's first word, hard-cut out when the next phrase/card lands; the card replaces the running line on the same frame. Text carries across picture cuts. No fade, pop, slide, highlight or idle motion.

OTHER TEXT
4. Hook: the claim card from frame 0 over the speaker holding the product; end it with a 12-frame full-frame {{ACCENT}} light flash that washes the card out, then cut to the running caption.
5. End: the product name as the last keyword card over a slow push into a macro of {{LOGO}}.
6. No titles, lower thirds, stickers or separate end card.

EDIT DEVICES
7. One feature = one insert shown in the same second it is named (handheld macro, locked overhead top-down, in-use shot); median shot ~31 frames, never over ~90; ~60 cuts/min in the first ~150 frames, ~36 after. Cut on motion (swings, hands, zips). Prove the boldest claim live (wide demo + macro result). One low-opacity {{ACCENT_2}} light leak early in the body.

GRADE
8. Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: cinematic warm-on-cool, tungsten practicals vs cool walls, deep blacks, slightly desaturated.

AUDIO
9. Continuous VO, no music bed; whoosh/hit on product swings and card swaps (~40 % of cuts), a riser or impact into the flash. Master to about -14.2 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render a test frame with the card line "RESISTANT" and one with a running caption "key word", over a dark area, and measure:
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test.mp4> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.2,0.40,0.8,0.60 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60"
   Required at the default font: "RESISTANT" ink 3.83 % ±0.5 of height and 49.3 % ±2 of width, centred at 50 % ±0.5. Running caption: expected ink from video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py ({{FONT_BODY}}, 50 px; reference 2.34 % H for lowercase lines with ascenders and descenders). With brand fonts, compute both with fit_font.py and match within ±0.5 % H.
